scientific_claim: A within-person multi-domain change marker might identify independently confirmed cardiovagal/adrenergic autonomic deterioration earlier or more reliably than existing tests.
clinical_target: Longitudinal worsening of cardiovagal and/or adrenergic function on independently interpreted clinical autonomic tests; no generalized ANS claim without sudomotor measurement.
population: Not fixed: requires disease-specific inclusion criteria and controls before a clinical study.
novelty_gap: UNVERIFIED: within-person multi-domain recovery change and reference-based improvement must be screened for exact prior art.
reference_standard: Autonomic reflex testing and domain-specific CASS subscores, with independently adjudicated changes; no appropriate longitudinal dataset acquired.
available_data: PhysioNet PRCP: healthy stand/tilt ECG and BP; engineering only
PhysioNet CDED/CVES: small diseased/control challenge cohorts; independent autonomic dysfunction labels unverified
next_falsifiable_test: Confirm PRCP repeated-challenge timing, test-retest variation and negative controls for cardiovagal and BP features; do not calculate clinical detection accuracy.
rejection_rule: Reject the current candidate if apparent deterioration lies within measurement noise or fails to add blinded clinically important discrimination relative to established reflex tests once ground-truth data become available.

G1_TARGET.note: Needs a narrowly specified disorder and study population

G3_REFERENCE.note: No accessible paired repeated clinical CASS deterioration cohort

G4_ANALYTICAL.note: PRCP repeatability and ABP alignment have not been validated

G5_INCREMENTAL.note: No independent clinical outcomes or measured comparator yet
